_comment: Layout of the /map city. Districts are chapters of Ayaan's life; buildings inside them are GitHub repos, placed automatically. Landmarks are hand-placed. Edit freely; the renderer reads this at open.

landmarks.label: AdvanceIQ.ai
landmarks.body: the day job. solo-built ARIA, an llm agent that lets merchant-cash-advance / revenue-based-finance clients query analytics in plain english. mastra + vercel ai sdk, next.js, custom sse.

landmarks.label: WingMic
landmarks.body: your social ram, on disk. speak for 10 to 30 seconds after meeting someone; an llm builds a knowledge graph you can query in plain english. has an mcp server so claude desktop and cursor can read it.

landmarks.label: Monroe University
landmarks.body: finishing the m.s. in computer science here. graduate coursework at the university of michigan in fall 2024 before that.

landmarks.label: blog
landmarks.body: build logs, takes on agents and tooling, notes from san francisco. also readable inside the terminal with /read <slug>.

landmarks.label: shipping dock
landmarks.body: every commit, pr and star from the last 90 days leaves the city through this dock. type /activity in the terminal for the list.
